    """
    LRUCache
    --------

    A thread-unsafe, high-performance Least Recently Used (LRU) cache with
    optional Time-To-Live (TTL) expiry for each entry.

    The cache uses an OrderedDict to maintain insertion/access order.
    On every `get` or `set`, the accessed key is moved to the end of the
    OrderedDict, marking it as the most recently used. When the cache
    exceeds its maximum capacity, the least recently used item (the first
    item in the OrderedDict) is evicted.
